path_entropy_formula: H(B | fixed script, observed queue lengths/cursors, solvable reference state) = -sum_b p(b) log2 p(b)
conditioning_scope: Queue sizes, cursors and existing record metadata fixed; remaining relevant item category/status vary. Counter prior remains 0..3; toggles and status widgets vary.
button_choice_definition: sum_t log2(number of enabled semantic buttons before correct action t), including Done; evaluated on the original oracle trace; reported separately from entropy
interpretation: Unweighted additive difficulty score. The components may overlap; this is not joint Shannon entropy or a model success probability. No independence assumed.
protocol: Same saved model outcomes; button counts from complete correct oracle traces.

binning.method: Accumulate adjacent fixed-width bins until minimum count, then merge an undersized final group backward. Binning ignores success labels.

intervals: Approximate 95% Wilson intervals; related templates limit independence.
